name: midad-arabic-sources
description: Import classical Arabic sources (tafsīrs, Qur'ān translations, ḥadīth, riwāyāt) into the vault, transliterate Arabic, and export references to Zotero.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && mkdir -p ../../.obsidian/plugins/midad-arabic-sources && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css ../../.obsidian/plugins/midad-arabic-sources/ && cp -R scripts midad-arabic-sources-import-templates ../../.obsidian/plugins/midad-arabic-sources/
scripts.bump: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json package.json package-lock.json
scripts.release: version=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") && git commit -m "$version" && git tag "$version" && git push && git push --tags

author: Joseph Hill <jbhill@ualberta.ca>
